name: Quick Disabler
author: Nayon Islam

sections.description:
Quick Plugin Disabler helps you instantly disable all active plugins except itself with a single click.
Need to find out which plugin is breaking your site? This tool is built for exactly that.
Use the Re-enable Plugins button to bring everything back—no need to reactivate plugins one by one.

✅ Perfect for:
– Troubleshooting plugin conflicts
– Debugging white screen issues
– Simplifying your dev workflow

Features:

  • Disable all active plugins (except this one)
  • Re-enable them all again
  • Powered by AJAX — no page reloads
  • Works on multisite
  • Lightweight & admin-only access

Author Information

Author URL: https://profiles.wordpress.org/webnayon
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate it via the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Plugins page and click:
    • Disable All Plugins (Except This)
    • or Re-enable Plugins
sections.faq:
What happens if I refresh the page after disabling plugins?

All disabled plugins will remain deactivated until you click the Re-enable Plugins button. Your plugin list will not refresh automatically unless you manually do so or use the button.

Is this plugin safe to use on live websites?

Yes! However, it’s recommended to always backup your site before making mass changes — especially on production environments.

Can non-admin users access this plugin?

No. Only users with the manage_options capability (typically Administrators) can access and use this plugin.
